error[ZBX-E0555]: the registry refused a blob upload
  while  pushing an image
  cause  registry.test refused closing the upload for blob sha256:5ea5c582993b:
         it answered 400
  host   registry.test
  status 400
  code   DIGEST_INVALID
  blob   sha256:5ea5c582993b6feccfe888c5dc82ac2c4e3a010a4854e4b419d32dc3cd0706c8
  fix    run the same command again; what the registry already holds is not sent twice
  more   zbx explain E0555
